notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting Temur Battlecrier
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath targeting Temur Battlecrier
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.
